collision_check: Searched openkit-*/fbx for pin|wire|draw|head|cutter|snip|blank: hits prop-tumbler-pin-tray, prop-binding-wire-spool, prop-cutting-wire-frame, prop-nail-header-die, prop-tin-snips, prop-diamond-point-cutter, various *-blank. All 4 ids free; no openkit-pin-maker pack existed.
judgment_calls: Draw plate: flat iron bar + tang, 6 graduated hole marks (inset soot quads, not boolean holes, for tri budget); pivot at plate centre so bbox is offset +X by tang
Pin blank tray: brass (period-typical pin wire) blanks, 5 headless, distinct from bone-button/peg/tumbler trays
Heading die: small oak block + iron heading cup + shank groove; distinct from nail-header-die (iron bolster plate with 2 bosses + hardy lug)
Wire cutters 0.124 m short beaked nippers w/ cord grips; distinct from tin-snips (sheet shears, long blades)

Contact-sheet eye-check: pass 1 found cutters grip blocks detached from handles (handle splay sign wrong) - fixed; tray walls lowered to 10 mm and blanks thickened to 4 mm. Remaining: single-colour workbench contact-sheet shots make brass blanks and hole marks read faintly; geometry itself is sound, no floating parts
